We know this is a -- golden triangle because is the perpendicular bisector of (in order to fold vertex onto the center ), so must be isosceles, with angle due to the regular pentagon.

Rather than trigonometry, it is well known that due to the golden triangle. Since both pentagons are regular, they are similar.
